title: Flood dated up to 40,000 years ago from ice cores
place_text: Mesopotamia / Greenland and Antarctic ice cores

tellings.quote: could be up to 40,000 years ago based on looking at ice course sampling and previous climatic events of when floods could have occurred

plain: The great flood of the old Mesopotamian stories, the one also told in the Bible and the Gilgamesh epic, could have happened as long as 40,000 years ago. Matt LaCroix, an author who writes about lost ancient civilisations, makes this case on the show. He bases it on ice cores drilled from Greenland and Antarctica and on past climate events that show when floods could have happened, and names no source. If he is right, the flood memory would be far older than history is usually thought to reach.
